card.name: Or/to after Moderate in severity lists
card.fires_on: The linking word "or" or "to" right after a severity or qualifier word such as Moderate, Strong, Personal or Mechanical, in contraindication and dosing lists. It also fires weakly on a few partway-through-word pieces.
